subject: Hybrid security walkthrough plan: pre-record + live Q&A
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <security@finvault.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: RedTeam Labs <redteam@redteamlabs.io>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security walkthrough — hybrid format request

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. For our SOC 2 / pen test intake I wanted to propose a hybrid format that helps our distributed team: a short pre-recorded evidence playback (20–30 minutes) covering control mappings, network diagrams, and sample logs, followed by a live Q&A (30–45 minutes) focused on technical clarifications and pen-test scope.

Why this helps: several of our stakeholders are APAC-based and can’t always attend live; the playback lets reviewers pre-read artifacts and bring targeted questions to the live session. We’d like the playback shared at least 48 hours before the live Q&A.

Ask: can Redwood run the playback (or share a recording) and host one live Q&A per region? Proposed windows below — if you can share 2–3 available slots (US, EU, APAC) we’ll lock one per region. Also please call out which artifacts you’ll include and whether you can record the live Q&A for our audit record.

High-level items we need covered:
- SOC 2 scope and control owner mapping
- Data residency / DPA clause implications for log retention
- Pen-test vendor access model and signal collection
- Evidence index and where artifacts live

Happy to loop in our RedTeam provider (cc’d) for scope alignment.

Thanks,
Asha Reddy
Head of Security — FinVault
security@finvault.com

Attachments: none in this message; prefer Redwood to surface the playback artifacts as a drive link.

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <security@finvault.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — hybrid format request

Asha — thanks for the clear ask, this format works well for us. Proposed playbook from Redwood:

1) Pre-recorded playback (25 minutes) — short walkthrough of the control map, infra diagram, and where evidence lives. We’ll include a clickable evidence index and timecodes for each control.
2) Live Q&A (35 minutes) — engineering + security leads on the call; record and share the recording and transcript for your audit purposes.

We can host three region-specific live Q&A sessions (US / EU / APAC) or consolidate into two — up to you. Below are concrete slot options (all times in UTC for clarity):
- Option A (US-friendly): Wed 2027-05-05 17:00 UTC (US/EMEA overlap)
- Option B (EU-friendly): Thu 2027-05-06 09:00 UTC
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Fri 2027-05-07 01:00 UTC

If you prefer one consolidated live session we can do Option A and record it; otherwise we’ll run the same playback before each regional call.

Artifacts we’ll provide: evidence-index.xlsx (mapping + links), short pre-recording (MP4) with slide deck, and a 1-page controls summary. I attached a short instructions PDF for playback creation and a proposed slot grid (ICS) for calendar invites.

Can you confirm: preferred region(s) to run, which slot you want, and whether RedTeam Labs would like to join the US or EU session?

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

Attachments: pre-recording-instructions.pdf; proposed-slot-grid.ics; evidence-index.xlsx

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Reddy <security@finvault.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — hybrid format request

Looping in engineering and the controls team. We can own the playback recording — I’ll record a short demo of the infra diagram and control-owner handoffs. Confirming internal attendees for the live Q&A:
- Olga Petrov (Controls Lead)
- Soojin Lee (Platform Security)
- Kim Park (Legal / DPA clarifications)
- Rafael (SE to run live demo snippets)

We’ll attach a checklist of artifacts we plan to include: network topology (pdf), retention policies (pdf), sample audit logs (redacted), and the evidence-index.xlsx (links to Drive). If FinVault can share any specific items you want highlighted in the playback (e.g., SSO logs, encryption key custody notes), send them over and we’ll timecode the recording.

Note: for the APAC window (Option C) we’ll need someone on the team to cover 01:00 UTC — happy to rotate but prefer to run a single consolidated session if you have most stakeholders able to join Option A.

— Olga

From: Asha Reddy <security@finvault.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: RedTeam Labs <redteam@redteamlabs.io>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — hybrid format request

Rafael / Olga — thanks, this all looks good. Quick answers:
- We’d like a US-friendly live session (Option A) as the primary slot and then a recording available for APAC reviewers.
- RedTeam Labs will join the US session for scope alignment.
- Please include SSO logs and encryption KMS custody notes in the playback — those are priority items.

Can you send the playback link 48 hours before the live Q&A (so target share by Mon 2027-05-03 17:00 UTC if slot stays Wed 2027-05-05 17:00 UTC). Also confirm recording/transcript retention window for our audit (we typically retain evidence for 2 years).

Asha

P.S. We’re good with the recording of the live Q&A; please add doc retention details in the evidence-index.xlsx

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <security@finvault.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, RedTeam Labs <redteam@redteamlabs.io>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — hybrid format request

Great — we’ll lock Option A: Wed 2027-05-05 17:00 UTC (US/EMEA overlap). Action items:
- Redwood: produce and share playback link + evidence-index.xlsx by Mon 2027-05-03 17:00 UTC (Rafael / Olga)
- FinVault: confirm final attendee list and any last-minute artifact highlights (Asha)
- RedTeam Labs: confirm whether you need additional access for pre-engagement review (RedTeam)

Retention: we will keep the recording + transcript in our secure Drive for 2 years by default and can provide an export for your auditors on request. I’ve attached the proposed slot grid (ICS) — you should see a calendar invite shortly once we publish the playback link.

Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up when the playback is uploaded and share timecodes for each control.

— Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: pre-recording-instructions.pdf; evidence-index.xlsx; proposed-slot-grid.ics
